youtube.title: Why Soda Can Tabs Stay Attached 🥤 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Early pull-tab cans had a ring you tore off and threw away. The discarded rings littered beaches and parks, cut bare feet, and some people accidentally swallowed them after dropping them into the can. In 1975 engineer Daniel Cudzik of Reynolds Metals invented the stay-on tab, which bends a section of the lid inward and stays riveted on.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
